# finance-system-desk-webpage-public

**PUBLIC, CODE ONLY, NO FINANCIAL DATA.** The Finance Desk web page, served by GitHub Pages at
https://dralvinyang.github.io/finance-system-desk-webpage-public/. Alvin opens it on his iPhone and
MacBook Air to see what is due and to enter what only he knows.

The page holds no figures and no key. It reads its data from the private repository
finance-system-desk-mailbox-private with a key kept only in each device's browser. `config.json` here
names that repository and nothing else.

**Do not edit here.** The master copy is `finance-desk-webpage/` in the private repository
DrAlvinYang/Finance, copied here by `python3 tools/finance-desk.py deploy`. **Do not publish any other
GitHub Pages site on this account:** every Pages site of an account shares one web address, so another
site could read the key this page keeps.

Set up 2026-09-13 under decision D-2026-09-13-01.
